tools.name: browse_styles
tools.description: Show the Clypmint editing styles that are ready to use.

tools.name: edit_video
tools.description: Edit one video in Clypmint. Attach the video file when the chat supports file uploads. Without a file, Clypmint returns a private upload link for the user that works for 15 minutes, and starts editing when the video arrives. The linked account's credits and limits apply. Preserve operation_id on ret

tools.name: check_video
tools.description: Check upload and editing progress, then show the finished video when it is ready.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List up to 20 recent videos in the linked Clypmint account.

tools.name: revise_video
tools.description: Ask Clypmint to change a finished video in plain words. The account's available revision rounds apply. Preserve operation_id and base_version on retries. Use a new operation_id for a deliberate new change, then check the result.

tools.name: copy_style
tools.description: Build a reusable editing style from one reference video shared by link or file. This uses one of the linked account's style copies.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the Clypmint profile linked to this request.

labels.name: fix_captions
labels.description: Fix caption words or the key-word colour of a finished video, without a new edit; timing never moves. Either rewrite lines (from, to, text from get_project_context captions; from and to are source word numbers, which get_transcript also gives) or swap words everywhere with replace: [{ heard, spelled

labels.name: get_video_activity
labels.description: While a video is being made, read what the editor is doing: its stage, minutes left, the paper edit, each step (looked at footage, searched, previewed) and the names it heard. Use it to narrate progress instead of waiting silently. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: get_thread
labels.description: Read the change history of a video, oldest first: every round of changes asked in words, direct edit and caption fix, with who asked, its status and the version it made. For just the versions use list_versions; for a video still being made, get_video_activity. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: list_versions
labels.description: List the versions of a video, newest last, and which one is live. Use with restore_version to undo. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: restore_version
labels.description: Undo: make an earlier version of a video live again, with its version_id from list_versions. Nothing is deleted: the version it replaces stays in the list and can be brought back the same way. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: save_clip
labels.description: Keep one finished output of a video (a clip, a hook or the main video, by its output_id from check_video) as a reusable asset. Its asset_id goes in asset_ids of edit_video or create_video, so the clip can open another video, sit inside one or become the whole video. For a picture or song from outsid

labels.name: remember
labels.description: Keep one lasting preference for every later video of this brand, in plain words: caption size, pace, sound effects, colours, "own footage first", or how a name is spelled. Each call adds one; a newer preference about the same thing wins over the older one. list_memory shows them and forget removes o

labels.name: list_memory
labels.description: List what Clypmint remembers for a brand: its preferences, looks and spellings, each with the id forget takes. Read it to answer "what do you remember?" or before remember, to avoid saying the same thing twice. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: forget
labels.description: Forget one remembered preference by its id from list_memory. Later videos leave it out; videos already made do not change. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: create_videos
labels.description: Make up to 10 faceless videos in one call, each from an idea or an exact script; defaults apply to every item unless it says otherwise. For one video use create_video; for a month of posts, plan_content. Every item is checked before any starts, and the same operation_id on a retry never makes double

labels.name: plan_content
labels.description: Start a content calendar for a topic, for "start a faceless account" or "a month of posts about X": count faceless videos (1-31) over days (7-31), each with a title, hook, the exact script, caption, hashtags and a posting time. Best: write the ideas yourself and send them as items (taken as written,

labels.name: edit_content_plan
labels.description: Change ideas in a content calendar by their number (n) before they are made or posted: title, hook, script, caption, hashtags, posting time, platforms, or removed: true to drop one (false puts it back). Only the fields sent change. Words cannot change once an idea is being made. Cost: Free: no credi

labels.name: get_content_plan
labels.description: Read a content calendar from plan_content: each idea’s words and state (draft, making, ready, needs_connect, needs_time, scheduled, posted, failed), its video and post, and the credit quote. Use it to show the calendar or follow its videos; edit_content_plan changes it. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: get_basic_info
labels.description: Start here for a video you will edit: its shape (width, height), length, frame rate, live version_id, outputs, and what this version takes (can_cut, limits). Then read get_timeline and get_transcript, and look with get_screenshot. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: get_timeline
labels.description: The layers of a video with their times, text, colour, place and what each can change (can), and every overlay in full. Paged by offset. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: get_transcript
labels.description: Every spoken word with its number, its start and end seconds on the video's clock and its source number, paged. Word numbers are what cut takes, source numbers what fix_captions lines take; seconds place overlays, graphics and sounds on what is said. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: get_screenshot
labels.description: Draws up to 6 moments of the video as saved (captions, graphics, overlays and all), as images. Look before you change a moment and again after. A first look at a version can take a few seconds. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: get_guide
labels.description: How to edit on this canvas, and our editors' craft: start (the loop), canvas, graphics (the code API), captions, sound, motion, type-and-placement, faceless-explainer, talking-video, references. Read start once, and graphics before write_graphic. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: get_font_family_info
labels.description: The fonts the renderer has: caption fonts (set_captions), text overlay fonts (put_overlay) and the families graphics can use (write_graphic). Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: search_sounds
labels.description: Searches Clypmint's licensed sound effect library by meaning and character, with each sound's length and where its onset, peak and end are. Place them with set_audio sound_effects. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: import_media
labels.description: Brings a picture, clip or song into a video from a public link (a fal or Higgsfield output) or from a file on this computer (file, then staging_key), and returns its asset_id for put_overlay, add_clip or set_audio. Clips up to 100 MiB, pictures and songs up to 32 MiB. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: put_overlay
labels.description: Places text, a picture or a clip on the video for chosen seconds, in a box (x, y its centre; width, height; fractions of the frame), with an optional animation. overlay_id replaces that overlay. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: write_graphic
labels.description: A motion graphic written as code (a Canvas 2D draw function run per frame in Clypmint's sandbox): charts, maps, labels, anything drawn. Read get_guide graphics first. Text only from slots (d.slots.name), the same frame for the same t, fonts from get_font_family_info, a new name each time. Saved on i

labels.name: update_layer
labels.description: Changes one layer from get_timeline: move, scale or rotate it, its text, colour or visibility, a footage layer's times, or the picture or clip it shows. Only what its can list allows. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: delete_layer
labels.description: Removes an overlay (ov_ id) or hides a layer. To take footage time out, use cut. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: cut
labels.description: Takes stretches out of the video by film seconds or by word numbers, and closes the gap (everything after moves earlier). A cut never splits a word. Read again before the next change. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: set_captions
labels.description: Changes the caption block: on or off, size, position, font, colours, case, language and spellings. To rewrite chosen caption lines use fix_captions. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: set_audio
labels.description: Music (Clypmint's songs or theirs, where it starts, its level, ducking under speech), exact sound effects from search_sounds each landed on a second, the style's own effects, and the footage's own sound. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: set_look
labels.description: Colour grade, camera (zooms off, shake off, a punch-in), the shape (9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:5, or another output beside this one), a speaker cut-out with captions behind the head, and a replay of the whole video at a speed. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: add_clip
labels.description: Puts another of their videos into the edit with its own sound: at the end, or at a film second (everything after moves later). Saved on its own. Cost: Free: no credits.

labels.name: browse_styles
labels.description: Show the editing styles the user can pick: ready styles and their own saved copies (own: true, with style_version), each with its content format (faceless/motion/talking), shapes, best uses and inputs (a motion style has inputs.voice: none). Also lists the 21 narrators with their accents and auditio

labels.name: edit_video
labels.description: Edit the user's own footage into a finished video. Put what they asked for in its field (kind, length, style_id, the song, formats only when they asked for a shape); instructions holds only anything else, in their own words. Clypmint watches the footage itself: never describe it or ask the user how

labels.name: check_video
labels.description: Check a video and show it. While the upload or the edit is still running, this waits for news before answering (up to 20 seconds; 50 in Claude), so call it again right away only if the user is waiting; the video card updates itself. state is waiting (give the user the upload link), uploading, editin

labels.name: list_videos
labels.description: List the linked account's 20 most recent videos (videos only, not saved pictures or songs), each with its id (the video_id other tools take), title, state and length. Use it to find the video to check or change; check_video shows one video in full.

labels.name: revise_video
labels.description: Change a finished video in plain words, or ask about it. A change asked for in words costs 1 to 2 credits (dry_run: true says the price and sends nothing); exact edits with the direct edit tools and fix_captions are free. It can cut words or moments; restyle captions (size, place, font, colour, on o

labels.name: copy_style
labels.description: Build a reusable editing style from one reference video shared by link or file. mode clone (the default) is the deep copy: it measures the reference and writes its own captions and motion; the linked account includes style copies every month at no credit cost, and once they are used each costs 25 cr

labels.name: adjust_style
labels.description: Change one of the linked account's saved styles in plain words, for example 'bigger yellow captions, no zooms' or 'open on the strongest line'. Saves it as the style's next version; every later video in that style follows it, and earlier versions are kept. Preserve operation_id on retries.

labels.name: get_account_identity
labels.description: Return only the stable identity and display labels of the account represented by this request. Used for account linking. For account rights, credits and usage use get_profile.

labels.name: get_profile
labels.description: Return the Clypmint profile linked to this request, with its credits (used and included this billing month, and when they renew) and videos used, so you can say what a request will use before spending.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_video_activity" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: While a video is being made, read what the editor is doing: its stage, minutes left, the paper edit, each step (looked at footage, searched, previewed) and the …

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "write_graphic" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: video_id, base_version, output_id, operation_id, name, start, end, code, slots, replaces, preview_at

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_video" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Check a video and show it. While the upload or the edit is still running, this waits for news before answering (up to 20 seconds; 50 in Claude), so call it agai…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "revise_video" is 1370 chars, far longer than this server's median (263). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Change a finished video in plain words, or ask about it. A change asked for in words costs 1 to 2 credits (dry_run: true says the price and sends nothing); exac…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: import_asset, get_thread, get_content_plan, get_transcript · Private data: import_asset, list_assets, import_media, edit_video, check_video, copy_style · Public sink: create_video, plan_content, get_content_plan, edit_video, check_video, revise_video · Destructive: create_video, get_project_context, create_videos, edit_content_plan, write_graphic, delete_layer, browse_styles, edit_video.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: import_asset, get_thread, get_content_plan, get_transcript · Private data: import_asset, list_assets, import_media, edit_video, check_video, copy_style · Public sink: create_video, plan_content, get_content_plan, edit_video, check_video, revise_video · Destructive: create_video, get_project_context, create_videos, edit_content_plan, write_graphic, delete_layer, browse_styles, edit_video

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "browse_styles" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Show the Clypmint editing styles that are ready to use." → after: "Show the editing styles the user can pick: ready styles and their own saved copies (own: true, with style_version), each with its content format (faceless/motion/talking), shapes, best uses and inputs (a motion style has inputs.voice: none). Also lists the 21 narrators with their accents and auditio"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
